name.title: DP_ACCEL_HIGH_RATE
name.sysdesc: Data Product to collect high rate (32Hz), 1553 decoded accelerometer data. Intended use cases are the following GNC activities: Frequency-ID and Accelerometer Characterization.

field.sysdesc: Number of 32Hz frames collected for this time stamp. (32Hz)

dynamic_array.sysdesc: 1553 decoded accelerometer data collected per time stamp. (32Hz)

field.sysdesc: This is the decoded accelerometer A data from the prime IMU. The data source should be the same that is used to generate the tlm channel that is the same as the FSW Name, where PRIME = A (or) B.
